I went to a gaming convention last week, it was fantastic, I highly advise such activities!

I went with the idea of learning more about Fate, but when one of the Fate games was canceled, I ended up playing Firefly. Firefly is similar to Fate in that it's a narrative type game, with Plot Points instead of Fate Points, and similar rules to cover aspects, and so on.

One feature that was very fun was "Flashbacks". Here's how I plan to adapt it into my Fate Accelerated game. I think this would work fine without the Everway Vision Cards. I just like to include them as a way to encourage imaginative thought, and to keep track of how many flashbacks can happen in the game.

I got the idea for using the vision cards from a similar idea using Dixit cards.

Let me know what you think of this idea? Please feel free to discuss other rule changes you have added to Fate!

Extra rule - Fate New Aspect Flashback While Creating an Advantage, If you are creating a new aspect, anyone may suggest you perform a flashback.

To perform a flashback, choose one other player and act out a scene from your characters past using one of the three Everway Vision Cards, supplied by the GM, as inspiration. You and your fellow player may take a moment to plan the scene in private if you like (whispering or notes are fine too).

The goal of the flashback acting is to tie the new aspect or existing aspect to part of your character’s background, while using the Everway Vision Card for inspiration.

If the scene is appreciated by the other gamers you get an automatic success, and a Fate Point, from the GM.

When the scene is over, the Everway Vision Card is discarded. There can be only 3 flashbacks in a normal session.
Extra rule - Fate New Aspect Flashback
